_README: Every entry must carry `evidence`: a file:line in the app repo, or the live-ASC endpoint that proves the claim. An entry with an empty evidence string FAILS the gate — that is deliberate.

privacy.html::privacy_absolute::stays on.evidence: Nonogram/Core/Save/CloudKitSaveStore.swift:11 (the iCloud leg is NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore, CloudKit-free) and :137 (ubiquitousStore defaults to NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore.default); Docs/PRIVACY/DECLARATION.md section 5 reads 'First-party backend: None detected' after privacy_scan.py --scan, 2026-09-23
privacy.html::privacy_absolute::stays on.note: Scoped to GAME PROGRESS, which is written locally and mirrored only into the player's own iCloud key-value store. There is no server of ours in the path: the only two network hosts anywhere in the app are an apps.apple.com write-review deep link and the outbound links to this site, both recorded benign in the declaration. It does NOT claim the app sends nothing — the analytics, ads and purchase flows are disclosed in the table directly below this sentence.

privacy.html::privacy_absolute::we have.evidence: Nonogram/Resources/Nonogram.entitlements — the only iCloud entitlement is com.apple.developer.ubiquity-kvstore-identifier; there is NO com.apple.developer.icloud-container-identifiers key, so no CloudKit container exists to read. Nonogram/Core/Save/CloudKitSaveStore.swift:15 records that nothing in the file imports CloudKit or CKContainer, because an unused entitlement is a 2.4.5(i) risk. Verified 2026-09-23
privacy.html::privacy_absolute::we have.note: Scoped to the iCloud MIRROR in the sentence it sits in. NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore writes into the user's own private iCloud container; with no CloudKit container declared there is no developer-readable database and no API by which the developer could read those values.

privacy.html::privacy_absolute::no track.evidence: Nonogram/Resources/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy:12-13 (NSPrivacyTracking false, no NSPrivacyTrackingDomains); no NSUserTrackingUsageDescription and no requestTrackingAuthorization call in the app target (privacy_scan.py --scan 2026-10-03 section 6: all three False); ad layer archived at build.adfree2 2026-10-01 under Archived/ad-layer-2026-10-01/
privacy.html::privacy_absolute::no track.note: Scoped to tracking as Apple defines it (ATT). Apple Search Ads attribution via AdServices is ATT-exempt and is disclosed in the table above this heading.
